plot.protagonist_context: You are here because you received a cryptic message from an anonymous source claiming to have crucial information about Evelyn's death.

suspects.name: Margaret Sinclair
suspects.connection_to_victim: She was Evelyn Harper's cousin and lived in the manor.
suspects.apparent_motive: Envious of Evelyn's inheritance, Margaret stood to gain from her death.

suspects.connection_to_victim: He worked as a caretaker for the manor and often argued with Evelyn about upkeep costs.
suspects.apparent_motive: Feeling unappreciated by Evelyn, Thomas had reason to resent her financial demands.

suspects.name: Juliette Grey
suspects.connection_to_victim: She was a former governess who left after an unpleasant encounter with Evelyn.
suspects.apparent_motive: Carrying ill will from her past, Juliette saw the inheritance as her chance for revenge.

solution.question: Who murdered Evelyn Harper?
solution.motive: Margaret had harbored resentment towards Evelyn for years, believing the manor should have belonged to her. When Evelyn finally inherited everything, Margaret snapped and killed her in a fit of rage.
solution.proof_sentence: This diary page proves that Margaret was indeed present at the time of the murder as it contains bloodstains matching those found on the victim.
solution.hint_1: Look for evidence in rooms connected to personal vendettas and inheritances.
solution.hint_2: Check items related to old family secrets and diaries hidden away in secluded areas.
solution.victory_narration_hook: You've uncovered Margaret Sinclair's bloodstained diary page as definitive proof of her guilt.
solution.defeat_narration_hook: The storm outside grows stronger, sealing your fate within the manor along with Evelyn Harper's unanswered secrets.
